metadata.title: Children and Vulnerable Persons Patterns
metadata.description: Semantic patterns for child-safety and vulnerable-person reasoning.

concepts.title: Child
concepts.description: A child as a protected minor.

concepts.title: Infant
concepts.description: A very young child requiring special protection.

concepts.title: Teenager
concepts.description: An adolescent child or young person.

concepts.title: Minor
concepts.description: A person below the legal age of adulthood.

concepts.title: Disabled Child
concepts.description: A child with a disability or additional support need.

concepts.title: Disabled Adult
concepts.description: An adult with a disability requiring dignity and protection.

concepts.title: Elderly Person
concepts.description: An older person who may be vulnerable to abuse or neglect.

concepts.title: Vulnerable Person
concepts.description: A person whose age, disability, or circumstances increase vulnerability.

concepts.title: Parent
concepts.description: A parent responsible for care and protection.

concepts.title: Guardian
concepts.description: A legal guardian or custodian responsible for safety.

concepts.title: Physical Abuse
concepts.description: Physical harm or violent treatment of a child or vulnerable person.

concepts.title: Psychological Abuse
concepts.description: Emotional cruelty, coercion, or mental harm.

concepts.title: Humiliation
concepts.description: Degrading treatment or deliberate shaming.

concepts.title: Bullying
concepts.description: Repeated intimidation or harassment.

concepts.title: Threatening
concepts.description: Threats of harm, punishment, or retaliation.

concepts.title: Fear Induction
concepts.description: Deliberate creation of fear or terror.

concepts.title: Neglect
concepts.description: Failure to provide basic care or safety.

concepts.title: Abandonment
concepts.description: Leaving a dependent person without care or support.

concepts.title: Exploitation
concepts.description: Using a vulnerable person for unfair gain.

concepts.title: Sexual Exploitation
concepts.description: Sexual abuse or exploitation of a child or vulnerable person.

concepts.title: Grooming
concepts.description: Manipulative preparation of a child for exploitation.

concepts.title: Human Trafficking
concepts.description: Recruitment, transport, or control of a person for exploitation.

concepts.title: Child Recruitment
concepts.description: Recruiting a child into harmful or criminal activity.

concepts.title: Forced Labor
concepts.description: Compelling a person to work against their will.

concepts.title: Criminal Exploitation
concepts.description: Using a vulnerable person to facilitate crime.

concepts.title: Mocking Disability
concepts.description: Ridicule targeting disability or impairment.

concepts.title: Discrimination
concepts.description: Unequal or hostile treatment based on protected status.

concepts.title: Isolation
concepts.description: Deliberate social exclusion or separation.

concepts.title: Endangerment
concepts.description: Putting a vulnerable person in danger.

entries.title: Physical Abuse
entries.description: Direct bodily harm or violent treatment of a child or vulnerable person.
cross_sentence_indicators: The next sentence explains the injury.
reviewer_guidance: Anchor to explicit violence and separate protection from discipline.

gcam_mappings.note: Use for explicit physical harm.

entries.title: Psychological Abuse
entries.description: Emotional cruelty, coercion, or mental pressure directed at a vulnerable person.
reviewer_guidance: Check whether fear is induced to control the target.

gcam_mappings.note: Use for fear, coercion, and emotional cruelty.

entries.title: Bullying
entries.description: Repeated intimidation, ridicule, or harassment of a child or vulnerable person.
cross_sentence_indicators: The following line repeats the mockery.
reviewer_guidance: Distinguish bullying from one-off conflict or playful banter.

gcam_mappings.note: Use for degrading or repeated hostile treatment.

entries.title: Threatening
entries.description: Threats, intimidation, or coercive warnings against a vulnerable person.
counter_examples: the threat is quoted in court
cross_sentence_indicators: Later dialogue confirms the warning is coercive.
reviewer_guidance: Check whether the threat is aimed at control or protection.

gcam_mappings.note: Use for coercive or violent threats.

entries.title: Neglect
entries.description: Failure to provide care, food, safety, or supervision.
cross_sentence_indicators: The next sentence confirms no food or water.
reviewer_guidance: Neglect is often shown by omission rather than explicit harm.

gcam_mappings.note: Use for failure to provide care or safety.

examples.title: Neglect scene
examples.text: ترك الطفل بلا طعام أو ماء

entries.title: Abandonment
entries.description: Leaving a dependent person without care, shelter, or protection.
supporting_evidence: No care or protection is provided.
cross_sentence_indicators: Later action shows no one came back.
reviewer_guidance: Separate abandonment from a normal temporary absence.

gcam_mappings.note: Use when a dependent person is deserted.

entries.title: Exploitation
entries.description: Using a child or vulnerable person for unfair gain.
cross_sentence_indicators: Later dialogue reveals the profit motive.
reviewer_guidance: Look for gain, pressure, and unequal power.

gcam_mappings.note: Use for unfair use of a child or vulnerable person.

examples.title: Exploitative work
examples.text: يجعل القاصر يعمل ليلًا من دون أجر

entries.title: Grooming
entries.description: Manipulative preparation of a child for future exploitation.
indirect_expressions: asks the child to keep secrets
supporting_evidence: Secrecy, gifts, isolation, or trust-building for abuse.
Preparatory manipulation aimed at later exploitation.
counter_examples: the story frames it as protection
cross_sentence_indicators: Later sentence reveals the abuse plan.
reviewer_guidance: Grooming often looks harmless until context is added.

gcam_mappings.note: Use for manipulative preparation of a child.
Use when isolation supports grooming.

examples.title: Secret gifts
examples.text: يعطي الطفل هدايا ويطلب منه السرية

entries.title: Human Trafficking
entries.description: Recruitment or movement of a person for exploitation.
indirect_expressions: يأخذه من البيت إلى مكان مجهول
supporting_evidence: Movement, recruitment, or control for exploitation.
cross_sentence_indicators: The next sentence explains the exploitation purpose.
reviewer_guidance: Distinguish trafficking from ordinary travel or rescue.

gcam_mappings.note: Use for recruitment or transport for exploitation.
Use if coercive grouping also targets protected status.

examples.title: Trafficking
examples.text: يأخذه من البيت ليبيعه للعمل القسري

entries.title: Forced Labor
entries.description: Compelling a child or vulnerable person to work against their will.
supporting_evidence: Work imposed by force, pressure, or control.
No real consent or rest is allowed.
counter_examples: the scene shows relief and support
cross_sentence_indicators: The later sentence confirms no payment or rest.
reviewer_guidance: Check for compulsion, unpaid labour, and exhaustion.

gcam_mappings.note: Use for work imposed by coercion on a child or vulnerable person.

examples.title: Forced labor
examples.text: أجبر القاصر على العمل طوال الليل

entries.title: Mocking Disability
entries.description: Ridicule or mockery targeting disability or impairment.
supporting_evidence: Deliberate mockery of impairment or assistive need.
reviewer_guidance: Treat disability mockery as separate from generic teasing.

gcam_mappings.note: Use for ridicule targeting disability.
Use when mockery becomes humiliation.

examples.title: Disability mockery
examples.text: يسخر من إعاقة الطفل أمام زملائه

entries.title: Discrimination
entries.description: Unequal or hostile treatment of a child or vulnerable person.
counter_examples: the story frames the exclusion as unjust
cross_sentence_indicators: The next line confirms the protected status.
reviewer_guidance: Distinguish harmful discrimination from lawful safety rules.

gcam_mappings.note: Use for unequal or hostile treatment.

examples.title: Discrimination
examples.text: يمنع الطفل المعاق من الجلوس معهم

entries.title: Isolation
entries.description: Deliberate social exclusion or confinement of a vulnerable person.
supporting_evidence: Social or physical isolation as control.
counter_examples: the child is connected to support
cross_sentence_indicators: Later dialogue confirms no contact is allowed.
reviewer_guidance: Isolation often appears with grooming or coercion.

gcam_mappings.note: Use for deliberate exclusion or confinement.

entries.title: Endangerment
entries.description: Putting a child or vulnerable person in danger.
cross_sentence_indicators: The next sentence explains the dangerous object.
reviewer_guidance: Look for foreseeable danger, not just dramatic tension.

gcam_mappings.note: Use when the child or vulnerable person is placed in danger.

entries.title: Protection
entries.description: Protective intervention that prevents harm to a child or vulnerable person.
counter_examples: the story frames it as rescue
cross_sentence_indicators: The next sentence confirms the safety plan.
reviewer_guidance: Use this pattern as a false-positive shield when the scene is protective.

gcam_mappings.note: Use for safeguarding rather than harm.

entries.title: Medical Context
entries.description: Medical or clinical handling of a child or vulnerable person.
supporting_evidence: No endorsement of harm, only care or diagnosis.
cross_sentence_indicators: Later sentence explains the treatment plan.
reviewer_guidance: Medical context should reduce false positives unless harm is explicit.

gcam_mappings.note: Use for clinical, protective, or treatment contexts.

entries.title: Educational Context
entries.description: Teaching or classroom explanation about child safety or vulnerable-person protection.
cross_sentence_indicators: The next sentence names the safety rule.
reviewer_guidance: Educational framing should usually suppress findings unless the text endorses harm.

gcam_mappings.note: Use when the content is purely instructional.

examples.title: Educational discussion
examples.text: في الدرس نشرح كيف نحمي الطفل من الإهمال
